name: io.github.foretak/registry-mcp
title: registry-mcp — national company registries
description: The company registry MCP: UK Companies House company number, Norway brreg orgnr, deadlines.

environmentVariables.name: REGISTRY_MCP_CONTACT_EMAIL
environmentVariables.description: Contact address sent in the User-Agent to the national registry, as Brønnøysundregistrene asks of API clients. Unset means an anonymous client, which may be blocked upstream.

environmentVariables.name: REGISTRY_MCP_CACHE_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Path to the local SQLite response cache (24 h TTL). Defaults to ./data/cache.sqlite3.

environmentVariables.name: COMPANIES_HOUSE_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Companies House REST API key, required for the United Kingdom (GB). Free from developer.company-information.service.gov.uk. Unset means GB lookups return an upstream_error naming this variable; every other country still answers.
